description: A single one-pole lowpass filter with a CV input, linear and with no resonance

params.text: Sets the corner, 0.01Hz at fully counter-clockwise to 22kHz at fully clockwise

inputs.text: Added to the knob at a tenth of the knob's full travel per volt, which is about 2.1 octaves
The audio to filter; its channel count sets the polyphony of the module

notes: the bottom of the knob's travel is well below any audible frequency, so the filter works as a slew limiter on control voltages too
the CV jack is read at a divided rate rather than every sample, so it is for slow movement rather than audio-rate modulation
